# API Contracts

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### HTTP endpoints

No `routes/api.php`, no OpenAPI/GraphQL. All routes in `routes/web.php`.

| Family | Method + path | Auth |
|---|---|---|
| Public site | GET `/`, `/sobre`, `/contato`, `/termos`, `/privacidade`, `/reembolso`, `/cookies` | none |
| Auth | GET `/cadastro`, `/entrar`, `/esqueci-senha`, `/redefinir-senha/{token}` (guest); POST `/sair`; GET `/email/verificar`, `/email/verificar/{id}/{hash}` (signed, throttle 6,1) | guest / auth |
| Feed | GET `/r/{restaurant:slug}`; GET `/r/{slug}/categorias/{category}`; POST `/r/{slug}/visualizacoes` (throttle 120,1) | none |
| Ordering (CSRF-exempt, JSON) | POST `/r/{slug}/pedidos` (throttle 30,1; 201 with code, tracking token, WhatsApp message, Pix payload; 422 `issues`/`items`); POST `/r/{slug}/cupom` (30,1; checks a discount code); POST `/r/{slug}/pedidos/{token}/whatsapp` (60,1; `opened`/`confirmed`/`not_sent`); POST `/r/{slug}/eventos` (120,1; funnel, always 204) | none |
| Tracking | GET `/p/{token}`, `/p/{token}/status` (404 seven days after the order ends) | token |
| Courier | GET `/entregador/{token}`; POST `/entregador/{token}/{order}/entregue` (404 when revoked or not theirs) | token |
| Owner panel | GET `/painel`, `/painel/categorias`, `/pratos`, `/pratos/novo`, `/pratos/{dish}/editar`, `/pratos/{dish}/video`, `/assinatura`, `/aparencia`, `/aparencia/previa`, `/qr-code`, `/qr-code/imprimir`, `/qr-code/svg`, `/visualizacoes`, `/suporte`, `/suporte/{ticket}`, `/conta`, `/configuracoes`, `/complementos`, `/pedidos`, `/pedidos/{order}/comanda`, `/comanda-teste`, `/pdv`, `/caixa`, `/fiado`, `/relatorio`, `/cupons`, `/fidelidade`, `/clientes`, `/motoboys`, `/ajuda` | middleware `auth, auth.session, owner, verified.owner` |
| Impersonation | POST `/impersonacao/encerrar` | auth |
| Webhooks | POST `/webhooks/mux`; Stripe via Cashier route + `StripeWebhookListener` | signature |
| Dev only (local/testing) | `/dev/components`, `/dev/feed`, `/dev/feed/categorias/{category}` | none |
| Admin | `/admin` (Filament 5) | Filament auth |

Panel pages are Livewire full-page components (HTML), not JSON.

### Feed watch-time report

`POST /r/{slug}/visualizacoes` — JSON or `text/plain` beacon body. Validation: `session_token` required string ≤64; `views` array ≤100; `views.*.dish_id` integer; `views.*.seconds` numeric ≥0.
Responses: 204 ok; 403 suspended restaurant; 422 validation. Unknown/foreign dish ids ignored.

```json
{
  "session_token": "session-a",
  "views": [{ "dish_id": 12, "seconds": 4.2 }]
}
```

### Order placement (CT-01)

`POST /r/{slug}/pedidos` — body: `items[]` (`dish_id`, `quantity`, `notes`, `variant_id`, `size_id`, `flavor_ids[]`, `options[]`), `fulfillment` (`retirada|entrega`), `customer` (`name`, `phone`), `address` (`street`, `number`, `neighborhood`, `zone_id`, `lat`, `lng`…), `payment_method`, `change_for`, `promo_code`, `origin`, `campaign`. Prices are never read from the client. 201 → `code`, `tracking_token`, `total`, `delivery_fee(_pending)`, `message`, `whatsapp_url`, `pix_payload`. 422 → `issues[]` (`type`: `min_order_delivery`, `zone_not_served`, `promo_code`, closed store…) and `items[]` for unavailable products.

### Mux webhook

`POST /webhooks/mux`, header `Mux-Signature`; invalid → 403 `Invalid signature.`; valid → 200 `OK`. Handles `video.asset.ready`, `video.asset.errored`; other types ignored.

```json
{
  "type": "video.asset.ready",
  "data": {
    "id": "asset-abc",
    "status": "ready",
    "duration": 8.4,
    "playback_ids": [{ "id": "playback-xyz", "policy": "public" }]
  }
}
```

### Stripe webhook

Events handled by `StripeWebhookListener`: `customer.subscription.created|updated|deleted`, `invoice.paid` (billing_reason `subscription_create|subscription_cycle|subscription_update`), `invoice.payment_failed`. Signature checked by Cashier when `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` set. Exact Cashier path not verified here.

### Message formats

- Queue: default connection `database` (`config/queue.php`), table `jobs`; worker `--tries=1 --timeout=900`.
- Jobs take scalar ids: `GenerateDishVideo::dispatch($generation->id)`; `PollDishVideoGeneration`, `PurgeRestaurant`, `SmokeTestJob`.
- Retry/DLQ: no custom backoff found in the reviewed code; worker runs `--tries=1`.
